title: RIk Showreels  - My Framer Site
text: RIk Showreels  - My Framer Site Nick Kozyrev works about get in touch Nick Kozyrev works about get in touch Nick Kozyrev menu RIk Showreels Clients Rik Animation Service: Motion Design Two showreels for RIK Animation, each built around a distinct visual direction and approach to storytelling. 2024-2025 RIk Showreels Clients Rik Animation Service: Motion Design Two showreels for RIK Animation, each built around a distinct visual direction and approach to storytelling. 2024-2025 RIk Showreels Clients Rik Animation Service: Motion Design Two showreels for RIK Animation, each built around a distinct visual direction and approach to storytelling. 2024-2025 about I created two showreels for RIK Animation, one at the end of 2024 and another in 2025. Each was designed around a different visual approach to presenting the studio’s work. For both pieces, I developed the storyboard and visual direction, selected and arranged the shots, and handled the animation, editing, visual effects, and sound design. The first focused on 2D motion, while the second explored a more experimental digital language combining 3D elements, ASCII-style graphics, and a Windows XP-inspired opening. The second showreel was later presented at Comic-Con 2025. credits Project Coordination Timur Ohigonsky Art Director of Rik Animation Pavel Ivanishin other works Fast Bill 2025 Coffee Owl 2025 Kringga Showreel 2025 Trustat 2025 Union Studio 2023 Ghost VPN 2026 Punk Lab 2025 Midnight Club 2024-2025 Lightning 2024-2025 2026 Nick Kozyrev. telegram 2026 Nick Kozyrev. telegram Create a free website with Framer, the website builder loved by startups, designers and agencies.
